experiment.source: Clean zero images replace Gaussian noise in both training and sampling
experiment.conditioning: Neither model receives a separate source-conditioning input
experiment.pairing: Nearest five in pixel distance; target reuse allowed; train and official test splits paired separately
experiment.displayExamples: First six zeros from the official test split, excluded from training
experiment.denoising: Predict source zero from (1-t)*zero + t*five; convert to velocity (state - predicted_source)/t at midpoint time, then Euler step
experiment.flow: Predict five minus zero from (1-t)*zero + t*five; Euler updates
experiment.scope: Generalized source denoising, not standard Gaussian diffusion; identical linear path and Euler solver, different prediction targets and induced velocity-error weighting

teachingModel: Native 32×32 paired zero-to-five U-Nets; identical architecture and initialization, same pairs, times and training budget
imageTransform: Native 32×32 state, no resizing or padding. No clipping before feature extraction.
featureTransform: Frozen continued U-Net; mid-block features averaged over all ten labels at probe timestep 500; subtract original mean and multiply by original PC1/PC2 axes.
